title: In the Mood
author: Lindsey Dono, Julian Blechner, Yoyo Zhou
problems: Row 5 "half poussette - larks pull partners back then left around *next neighbors*" can't start from where the dancers are: Going left after backing up would take the pair out of the minor set.
The progression after row 5 "half poussette - larks pull partners back then left around *next neighbors*" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
